source.selection: Every frozen native 12H V1.7 confirmation candidate, independent of whether it was admitted, funded, or profitable.
source.identity: event_id is the frozen source key. Parse side from the final event_id token and verify symbol and entry_ms against the encoded contract and nanosecond timestamp.

feature.single_variable: Direction-signed change in realized funding pressure relative to the contract's preceding seven-day daily mean.
feature.formula: side * (sum(realized funding rates in latest causal 24h) - mean(sum(realized funding rates in each of the preceding seven causal 24h periods)))
feature.asof_cutoff: Exclude all settlements in the full UTC minute containing entry_ms. The eight exact 24h bins end at the open boundary floor(entry_ms, 1 minute); no funding record at or after that boundary is used.
feature.direction: side is +1 long and -1 short; lower pressure is more favorable to that direction.
feature.availability: Require all eight 24h bins to contain native realized settlements, a predecessor within 8h+120s of the first bin, and no native settlement gap above 8h+120s through the cutoff. Monthly archives also check constant funding_interval_hours segments. No zero filling or interpolation.

source_policy.required_support: Each event requires the eight feature days plus up to nine hours of predecessor support.
priority: Existing Binance official monthly fundingRate ZIPs in the original 12-symbol archive
Existing Binance official monthly fundingRate ZIPs in the 2040-account archive
A verified local Binance fundingRate API cache whose manifest covers the full needed symbol-month query range
Fetch only needed monthly fundingRate ZIPs from data.binance.vision
If a needed monthly ZIP is unavailable, fetch the precise needed month range from official Binance USD-M GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate
source_policy.fallback: Preserve HTTP status/receipt and official REST request-range manifest. The REST client enforces its shared funding endpoint request budget and paginates at the documented 1000-row cap.
source_policy.continuity_limitations: Monthly Binance ZIP rows include funding_interval_hours and constant-interval runs are checked for missing settlements. REST fundingRate rows do not include that interval field, so REST-only coverage can enforce the requested 8h maximum gap but cannot detect every missing row in a native 1h or 4h segment if the remaining gap stays below 8h.
